schema-creator.description: Creates JSON Schema validation files for skills, agents, hooks, workflows, and data structures. Ensures type safety and input validation across the framework.

scientific-skills.name: scientific-skills
scientific-skills.description: Comprehensive scientific research toolkit with 139 specialized skills for biology, chemistry, medicine, data science, and computational research. Transforms Claude into an AI research assistant with access to scientific databases, analysis tools, and domain-specific workflows.

scientific-skills/skills/adaptyv.name: scientific-skills/skills/adaptyv
scientific-skills/skills/adaptyv.description: Cloud laboratory platform for automated protein testing and validation. Use when designing proteins and needing experimental validation including binding assays, expression testing, thermostability measurements, enzyme activity assays, or protein sequence optimization. Also use for submitting experiments via API, tracking experiment status, downloading results, optimizing protein sequences for better expression using computational tools (NetSolP, SoluProt, SolubleMPNN, ESM), or managing protein design workflows with wet-lab validation.

scientific-skills/skills/aeon.name: scientific-skills/skills/aeon
scientific-skills/skills/aeon.description: This skill should be used for time series machine learning tasks including classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, and similarity search. Use when working with temporal data, sequential patterns, or time-indexed observations requiring specialized algorithms beyond standard ML approaches. Particularly suited for univariate and multivariate time series analysis with scikit-learn compatible APIs.

scientific-skills/skills/alphafold-datab.name: scientific-skills/skills/alphafold-database
scientific-skills/skills/alphafold-datab.description: Access AlphaFold 200M+ AI-predicted protein structures. Retrieve structures by UniProt ID, download PDB/mmCIF files, analyze confidence metrics (pLDDT, PAE), for drug discovery and structural biology.

scientific-skills/skills/anndata.name: scientific-skills/skills/anndata
scientific-skills/skills/anndata.description: Data structure for annotated matrices in single-cell analysis. Use when working with .h5ad files or integrating with the scverse ecosystem. This is the data format skill—for analysis workflows use scanpy; for probabilistic models use scvi-tools; for population-scale queries use cellxgene-census.

scientific-skills/skills/arboreto.name: scientific-skills/skills/arboreto
scientific-skills/skills/arboreto.description: Infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from gene expression data using scalable algorithms (GRNBoost2, GENIE3). Use when analyzing transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) to identify transcription factor-target gene relationships and regulatory interactions. Supports distributed computation for large-scale datasets.

scientific-skills/skills/astropy.name: scientific-skills/skills/astropy
scientific-skills/skills/astropy.description: Comprehensive Python library for astronomy and astrophysics. This skill should be used when working with astronomical data including celestial coordinates, physical units, FITS files, cosmological calculations, time systems, tables, world coordinate systems (WCS), and astronomical data analysis. Use when tasks involve coordinate transformations, unit conversions, FITS file manipulation, cosmological distance calculations, time scale conversions, or astronomical data processing.

scientific-skills/skills/benchling-integ.name: scientific-skills/skills/benchling-integration
scientific-skills/skills/benchling-integ.description: Benchling R&D platform integration. Access registry (DNA, proteins), inventory, ELN entries, workflows via API, build Benchling Apps, query Data Warehouse, for lab data management automation.

scientific-skills/skills/biopython.name: scientific-skills/skills/biopython
scientific-skills/skills/biopython.description: Comprehensive molecular biology toolkit. Use for sequence manipulation, file parsing (FASTA/GenBank/PDB), phylogenetics, and programmatic NCBI/PubMed access (Bio.Entrez). Best for batch processing, custom bioinformatics pipelines, BLAST automation. For quick lookups use gget; for multi-service integration use bioservices.

scientific-skills/skills/biorxiv-databas.name: scientific-skills/skills/biorxiv-database
scientific-skills/skills/biorxiv-databas.description: Efficient database search tool for bioRxiv preprint server. Use this skill when searching for life sciences preprints by keywords, authors, date ranges, or categories, retrieving paper metadata, downloading PDFs, or conducting literature reviews.

scientific-skills/skills/bioservices.name: scientific-skills/skills/bioservices
scientific-skills/skills/bioservices.description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.

scientific-skills/skills/brenda-database.name: scientific-skills/skills/brenda-database
scientific-skills/skills/brenda-database.description: Access BRENDA enzyme database via SOAP API. Retrieve kinetic parameters (Km, kcat), reaction equations, organism data, and substrate-specific enzyme information for biochemical research and metabolic pathway analysis.

scientific-skills/skills/cellxgene-censu.name: scientific-skills/skills/cellxgene-census
scientific-skills/skills/cellxgene-censu.description: Query the CELLxGENE Census (61M+ cells) programmatically. Use when you need expression data across tissues, diseases, or cell types from the largest curated single-cell atlas. Best for population-scale queries, reference atlas comparisons. For analyzing your own data use scanpy or scvi-tools.

scientific-skills/skills/chembl-database.name: scientific-skills/skills/chembl-database
scientific-skills/skills/chembl-database.description: Query ChEMBL bioactive molecules and drug discovery data. Search compounds by structure/properties, retrieve bioactivity data (IC50, Ki), find inhibitors, perform SAR studies, for medicinal chemistry.

scientific-skills/skills/cirq.name: scientific-skills/skills/cirq
scientific-skills/skills/cirq.description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.

scientific-skills/skills/citation-manage.name: scientific-skills/skills/citation-management
scientific-skills/skills/citation-manage.description: Comprehensive citation management for academic research. Search Google Scholar and PubMed for papers, extract accurate metadata, validate citations, and generate properly formatted BibTeX entries. This skill should be used when you need to find papers, verify citation information, convert DOIs to BibTeX, or ensure reference accuracy in scientific writing.

scientific-skills/skills/clinical-decisi.name: scientific-skills/skills/clinical-decision-support
scientific-skills/skills/clinical-decisi.description: Generate professional clinical decision support (CDS) documents for pharmaceutical and clinical research settings, including patient cohort analyses (biomarker-stratified with outcomes) and treatment recommendation reports (evidence-based guidelines with decision algorithms). Supports GRADE evidence grading, statistical analysis (hazard ratios, survival curves, waterfall plots), biomarker integration, and regulatory compliance. Outputs publication-ready LaTeX/PDF format optimized for drug development, clinical research, and evidence synthesis.

scientific-skills/skills/clinical-report.name: scientific-skills/skills/clinical-reports
scientific-skills/skills/clinical-report.description: Write comprehensive clinical reports including case reports (CARE guidelines), diagnostic reports (radiology/pathology/lab), clinical trial reports (ICH-E3, SAE, CSR), and patient documentation (SOAP, H&P, discharge summaries). Full support with templates, regulatory compliance (HIPAA, FDA, ICH-GCP), and validation tools.

scientific-skills/skills/clinicaltrials-.name: scientific-skills/skills/clinicaltrials-database
scientific-skills/skills/clinicaltrials-.description: Query ClinicalTrials.gov via API v2. Search trials by condition, drug, location, status, or phase. Retrieve trial details by NCT ID, export data, for clinical research and patient matching.

scientific-skills/skills/clinpgx-databas.name: scientific-skills/skills/clinpgx-database
scientific-skills/skills/clinpgx-databas.description: Access ClinPGx pharmacogenomics data (successor to PharmGKB). Query gene-drug interactions, CPIC guidelines, allele functions, for precision medicine and genotype-guided dosing decisions.

scientific-skills/skills/clinvar-databas.name: scientific-skills/skills/clinvar-database
scientific-skills/skills/clinvar-databas.description: Query NCBI ClinVar for variant clinical significance. Search by gene/position, interpret pathogenicity classifications, access via E-utilities API or FTP, annotate VCFs, for genomic medicine.

scientific-skills/skills/cobrapy.name: scientific-skills/skills/cobrapy
scientific-skills/skills/cobrapy.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

scientific-skills/skills/cosmic-database.name: scientific-skills/skills/cosmic-database
scientific-skills/skills/cosmic-database.description: Access COSMIC cancer mutation database. Query somatic mutations, Cancer Gene Census, mutational signatures, gene fusions, for cancer research and precision oncology. Requires authentication.

scientific-skills/skills/dask.name: scientific-skills/skills/dask
scientific-skills/skills/dask.description: Distributed computing for larger-than-RAM pandas/NumPy workflows. Use when you need to scale existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory or across clusters. Best for parallel file processing, distributed ML, integration with existing pandas code. For out-of-core analytics on single machine use vaex; for in-memory speed use polars.

scientific-skills/skills/datacommons-cli.name: scientific-skills/skills/datacommons-client
scientific-skills/skills/datacommons-cli.description: Work with Data Commons, a platform providing programmatic access to public statistical data from global sources. Use this skill when working with demographic data, economic indicators, health statistics, environmental data, or any public datasets available through Data Commons. Applicable for querying population statistics, GDP figures, unemployment rates, disease prevalence, geographic entity resolution, and exploring relationships between statistical entities.

scientific-skills/skills/datamol.name: scientific-skills/skills/datamol
scientific-skills/skills/datamol.description: Pythonic wrapper around RDKit with simplified interface and sensible defaults. Preferred for standard drug discovery including SMILES parsing, standardization, descriptors, fingerprints, clustering, 3D conformers, parallel processing. Returns native rdkit.Chem.Mol objects. For advanced control or custom parameters, use rdkit directly.

scientific-skills/skills/deepchem.name: scientific-skills/skills/deepchem
scientific-skills/skills/deepchem.description: Molecular ML with diverse featurizers and pre-built datasets. Use for property prediction (ADMET, toxicity) with traditional ML or GNNs when you want extensive featurization options and MoleculeNet benchmarks. Best for quick experiments with pre-trained models, diverse molecular representations. For graph-first PyTorch workflows use torchdrug; for benchmark datasets use pytdc.

scientific-skills/skills/deeptools.name: scientific-skills/skills/deeptools
scientific-skills/skills/deeptools.description: NGS analysis toolkit. BAM to bigWig conversion, QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprints), heatmaps/profiles (TSS, peaks), for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq visualization.

scientific-skills/skills/denario.name: scientific-skills/skills/denario
scientific-skills/skills/denario.description: Multiagent AI system for scientific research assistance that automates research workflows from data analysis to publication. This skill should be used when generating research ideas from datasets, developing research methodologies, executing computational experiments, performing literature searches, or generating publication-ready papers in LaTeX format. Supports end-to-end research pipelines with customizable agent orchestration.

scientific-skills/skills/diffdock.name: scientific-skills/skills/diffdock
scientific-skills/skills/diffdock.description: Diffusion-based molecular docking. Predict protein-ligand binding poses from PDB/SMILES, confidence scores, virtual screening, for structure-based drug design. Not for affinity prediction.

scientific-skills/skills/dnanexus-integr.name: scientific-skills/skills/dnanexus-integration
scientific-skills/skills/dnanexus-integr.description: DNAnexus cloud genomics platform. Build apps/applets, manage data (upload/download), dxpy Python SDK, run workflows, FASTQ/BAM/VCF, for genomics pipeline development and execution.

scientific-skills/skills/document-skills.name: scientific-skills/skills/document-skills/docx
scientific-skills/skills/document-skills.description: Document toolkit (.docx). Create/edit documents, tracked changes, comments, formatting preservation, text extraction, for professional document processing.

scientific-skills/skills/document-skills.name: scientific-skills/skills/document-skills/pdf
scientific-skills/skills/document-skills.description: PDF manipulation toolkit. Extract text/tables, create PDFs, merge/split, fill forms, for programmatic document processing and analysis.

scientific-skills/skills/document-skills.name: scientific-skills/skills/document-skills/pptx
scientific-skills/skills/document-skills.description: Presentation toolkit (.pptx). Create/edit slides, layouts, content, speaker notes, comments, for programmatic presentation creation and modification.

scientific-skills/skills/document-skills.name: scientific-skills/skills/document-skills/xlsx
scientific-skills/skills/document-skills.description: Spreadsheet toolkit (.xlsx/.csv). Create/edit with formulas/formatting, analyze data, visualization, recalculate formulas, for spreadsheet processing and analysis.

scientific-skills/skills/drugbank-databa.name: scientific-skills/skills/drugbank-database
scientific-skills/skills/drugbank-databa.description: Access and analyze comprehensive drug information from the DrugBank database including drug properties, interactions, targets, pathways, chemical structures, and pharmacology data. This skill should be used when working with pharmaceutical data, drug discovery research, pharmacology studies, drug-drug interaction analysis, target identification, chemical similarity searches, ADMET predictions, or any task requiring detailed drug and drug target information from DrugBank.

scientific-skills/skills/ena-database.name: scientific-skills/skills/ena-database
scientific-skills/skills/ena-database.description: Access European Nucleotide Archive via API/FTP. Retrieve DNA/RNA sequences, raw reads (FASTQ), genome assemblies by accession, for genomics and bioinformatics pipelines. Supports multiple formats.

scientific-skills/skills/ensembl-databas.name: scientific-skills/skills/ensembl-database
scientific-skills/skills/ensembl-databas.description: Query Ensembl genome database REST API for 250+ species. Gene lookups, sequence retrieval, variant analysis, comparative genomics, orthologs, VEP predictions, for genomic research.

scientific-skills/skills/esm.name: scientific-skills/skills/esm
scientific-skills/skills/esm.description: Comprehensive toolkit for protein language models including ESM3 (generative multimodal protein design across sequence, structure, and function) and ESM C (efficient protein embeddings and representations). Use this skill when working with protein sequences, structures, or function prediction; designing novel proteins; generating protein embeddings; performing inverse folding; or conducting protein engineering tasks. Supports both local model usage and cloud-based Forge API for scalable inference.

scientific-skills/skills/etetoolkit.name: scientific-skills/skills/etetoolkit
scientific-skills/skills/etetoolkit.description: Phylogenetic tree toolkit (ETE). Tree manipulation (Newick/NHX), evolutionary event detection, orthology/paralogy, NCBI taxonomy, visualization (PDF/SVG), for phylogenomics.

scientific-skills/skills/exploratory-dat.name: scientific-skills/skills/exploratory-data-analysis
scientific-skills/skills/exploratory-dat.description: Perform comprehensive exploratory data analysis on scientific data files across 200+ file formats. This skill should be used when analyzing any scientific data file to understand its structure, content, quality, and characteristics. Automatically detects file type and generates detailed markdown reports with format-specific analysis, quality metrics, and downstream analysis recommendations. Covers chemistry, bioinformatics, microscopy, spectroscopy, proteomics, metabolomics, and general scientific data formats.

scientific-skills/skills/fda-database.name: scientific-skills/skills/fda-database
scientific-skills/skills/fda-database.description: Query openFDA API for drugs, devices, adverse events, recalls, regulatory submissions (510k, PMA), substance identification (UNII), for FDA regulatory data analysis and safety research.

scientific-skills/skills/flowio.name: scientific-skills/skills/flowio
scientific-skills/skills/flowio.description: Parse FCS (Flow Cytometry Standard) files v2.0-3.1. Extract events as NumPy arrays, read metadata/channels, convert to CSV/DataFrame, for flow cytometry data preprocessing.

scientific-skills/skills/fluidsim.name: scientific-skills/skills/fluidsim
scientific-skills/skills/fluidsim.description: Framework for computational fluid dynamics simulations using Python. Use when running fluid dynamics simulations including Navier-Stokes equations (2D/3D), shallow water equations, stratified flows, or when analyzing turbulence, vortex dynamics, or geophysical flows. Provides pseudospectral methods with FFT, HPC support, and comprehensive output analysis.

scientific-skills/skills/gene-database.name: scientific-skills/skills/gene-database
scientific-skills/skills/gene-database.description: Query NCBI Gene via E-utilities/Datasets API. Search by symbol/ID, retrieve gene info (RefSeqs, GO, locations, phenotypes), batch lookups, for gene annotation and functional analysis.

scientific-skills/skills/generate-image.name: scientific-skills/skills/generate-image
scientific-skills/skills/generate-image.description: Generate or edit images using AI models (FLUX, Gemini). Use for general-purpose image generation including photos, illustrations, artwork, visual assets, concept art, and any image that is not a technical diagram or schematic. For flowcharts, circuits, pathways, and technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

scientific-skills/skills/geniml.name: scientific-skills/skills/geniml
scientific-skills/skills/geniml.description: This skill should be used when working with genomic interval data (BED files) for machine learning tasks. Use for training region embeddings (Region2Vec, BEDspace), single-cell ATAC-seq analysis (scEmbed), building consensus peaks (universes), or any ML-based analysis of genomic regions. Applies to BED file collections, scATAC-seq data, chromatin accessibility datasets, and region-based genomic feature learning.

scientific-skills/skills/geo-database.name: scientific-skills/skills/geo-database
scientific-skills/skills/geo-database.description: Access NCBI GEO for gene expression/genomics data. Search/download microarray and RNA-seq datasets (GSE, GSM, GPL), retrieve SOFT/Matrix files, for transcriptomics and expression analysis.

scientific-skills/skills/geopandas.name: scientific-skills/skills/geopandas
scientific-skills/skills/geopandas.description: Python library for working with geospatial vector data including shapefiles, GeoJSON, and GeoPackage files. Use when working with geographic data for spatial analysis, geometric operations, coordinate transformations, spatial joins, overlay operations, choropleth mapping, or any task involving reading/writing/analyzing vector geographic data. Supports PostGIS databases, interactive maps, and integration with matplotlib/folium/cartopy. Use for tasks like buffer analysis, spatial joins between datasets, dissolving boundaries, clipping data, calculating areas/distances, reprojecting coordinate systems, creating maps, or converting between spatial file formats.

scientific-skills/skills/get-available-r.name: scientific-skills/skills/get-available-resources
scientific-skills/skills/get-available-r.description: This skill should be used at the start of any computationally intensive scientific task to detect and report available system resources (CPU cores, GPUs, memory, disk space). It creates a JSON file with resource information and strategic recommendations that inform computational approach decisions such as whether to use parallel processing (joblib, multiprocessing), out-of-core computing (Dask, Zarr), GPU acceleration (PyTorch, JAX), or memory-efficient strategies. Use this skill before running analyses, training models, processing large datasets, or any task where resource constraints matter.

scientific-skills/skills/gget.name: scientific-skills/skills/gget
scientific-skills/skills/gget.description: Fast CLI/Python queries to 20+ bioinformatics databases. Use for quick lookups: gene info, BLAST searches, AlphaFold structures, enrichment analysis. Best for interactive exploration, simple queries. For batch processing or advanced BLAST use biopython; for multi-database Python workflows use bioservices.

scientific-skills/skills/gtars.name: scientific-skills/skills/gtars
scientific-skills/skills/gtars.description: High-performance toolkit for genomic interval analysis in Rust with Python bindings. Use when working with genomic regions, BED files, coverage tracks, overlap detection, tokenization for ML models, or fragment analysis in computational genomics and machine learning applications.

scientific-skills/skills/gwas-database.name: scientific-skills/skills/gwas-database
scientific-skills/skills/gwas-database.description: Query NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog for SNP-trait associations. Search variants by rs ID, disease/trait, gene, retrieve p-values and summary statistics, for genetic epidemiology and polygenic risk scores.

scientific-skills/skills/histolab.name: scientific-skills/skills/histolab
scientific-skills/skills/histolab.description: Lightweight WSI tile extraction and preprocessing. Use for basic slide processing tissue detection, tile extraction, stain normalization for H&E images. Best for simple pipelines, dataset preparation, quick tile-based analysis. For advanced spatial proteomics, multiplexed imaging, or deep learning pipelines use pathml.

scientific-skills/skills/hmdb-database.name: scientific-skills/skills/hmdb-database
scientific-skills/skills/hmdb-database.description: Access Human Metabolome Database (220K+ metabolites). Search by name/ID/structure, retrieve chemical properties, biomarker data, NMR/MS spectra, pathways, for metabolomics and identification.

scientific-skills/skills/hypogenic.name: scientific-skills/skills/hypogenic
scientific-skills/skills/hypogenic.description: Automated LLM-driven hypothesis generation and testing on tabular datasets. Use when you want to systematically explore hypotheses about patterns in empirical data (e.g., deception detection, content analysis). Combines literature insights with data-driven hypothesis testing. For manual hypothesis formulation use hypothesis-generation; for creative ideation use scientific-brainstorming.

scientific-skills/skills/hypothesis-gene.name: scientific-skills/skills/hypothesis-generation
scientific-skills/skills/hypothesis-gene.description: Structured hypothesis formulation from observations. Use when you have experimental observations or data and need to formulate testable hypotheses with predictions, propose mechanisms, and design experiments to test them. Follows scientific method framework. For open-ended ideation use scientific-brainstorming; for automated LLM-driven hypothesis testing on datasets use hypogenic.

scientific-skills/skills/iso-13485-certi.name: scientific-skills/skills/iso-13485-certification
scientific-skills/skills/iso-13485-certi.description: Comprehensive toolkit for preparing ISO 13485 certification documentation for medical device Quality Management Systems. Use when users need help with ISO 13485 QMS documentation, including (1) conducting gap analysis of existing documentation, (2) creating Quality Manuals, (3) developing required procedures and work instructions, (4) preparing Medical Device Files, (5) understanding ISO 13485 requirements, or (6) identifying missing documentation for medical device certification. Also use when users mention medical device regulations, QMS certification, FDA QMSR, EU MDR, or need help with quality system documentation.

scientific-skills/skills/kegg-database.name: scientific-skills/skills/kegg-database
scientific-skills/skills/kegg-database.description: Direct REST API access to KEGG (academic use only). Pathway analysis, gene-pathway mapping, metabolic pathways, drug interactions, ID conversion. For Python workflows with multiple databases, prefer bioservices. Use this for direct HTTP/REST work or KEGG-specific control.

scientific-skills/skills/labarchive-inte.name: scientific-skills/skills/labarchive-integration
scientific-skills/skills/labarchive-inte.description: Electronic lab notebook API integration. Access notebooks, manage entries/attachments, backup notebooks, integrate with Protocols.io/Jupyter/REDCap, for programmatic ELN workflows.

scientific-skills/skills/lamindb.name: scientific-skills/skills/lamindb
scientific-skills/skills/lamindb.description: This skill should be used when working with LaminDB, an open-source data framework for biology that makes data queryable, traceable, reproducible, and FAIR. Use when managing biological datasets (scRNA-seq, spatial, flow cytometry, etc.), tracking computational workflows, curating and validating data with biological ontologies, building data lakehouses, or ensuring data lineage and reproducibility in biological research. Covers data management, annotation, ontologies (genes, cell types, diseases, tissues), schema validation, integrations with workflow managers (Nextflow, Snakemake) and MLOps platforms (W&B, MLflow), and deployment strategies.

scientific-skills/skills/latchbio-integr.name: scientific-skills/skills/latchbio-integration
scientific-skills/skills/latchbio-integr.description: Latch platform for bioinformatics workflows. Build pipelines with Latch SDK, @workflow/@task decorators, deploy serverless workflows, LatchFile/LatchDir, Nextflow/Snakemake integration.

scientific-skills/skills/latex-posters.name: scientific-skills/skills/latex-posters
scientific-skills/skills/latex-posters.description: Create professional research posters in LaTeX using beamerposter, tikzposter, or baposter. Support for conference presentations, academic posters, and scientific communication. Includes layout design, color schemes, multi-column formats, figure integration, and poster-specific best practices for visual communication.

scientific-skills/skills/literature-revi.name: scientific-skills/skills/literature-review
scientific-skills/skills/literature-revi.description: Conduct comprehensive, systematic literature reviews using multiple academic databases (PubMed, arXiv, bioRxiv, Semantic Scholar, etc.). scientific-skills/skills/market-research.name: scientific-skills/skills/market-research-reports
scientific-skills/skills/market-research.description: Generate comprehensive market research reports (50+ pages) in the style of top consulting firms (McKinsey, BCG, Gartner). Features professional LaTeX formatting, extensive visual generation with scientific-schematics and generate-image, deep integration with research-lookup for data gathering, and multi-framework strategic analysis including Porter Five Forces, PESTLE, SWOT, TAM/SAM/SOM, and BCG Matrix.

scientific-skills/skills/markitdown.name: scientific-skills/skills/markitdown
scientific-skills/skills/markitdown.description: Convert files and office documents to Markdown. Supports PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, images (with OCR), audio (with transcription), HTML, CSV, JSON, XML, ZIP, YouTube URLs, EPubs and more.

scientific-skills/skills/matchms.name: scientific-skills/skills/matchms
scientific-skills/skills/matchms.description: Spectral similarity and compound identification for metabolomics. Use for comparing mass spectra, computing similarity scores (cosine, modified cosine), and identifying unknown compounds from spectral libraries. Best for metabolite identification, spectral matching, library searching. For full LC-MS/MS proteomics pipelines use pyopenms.

scientific-skills/skills/matlab.name: scientific-skills/skills/matlab
scientific-skills/skills/matlab.description: MATLAB and GNU Octave numerical computing for matrix operations, data analysis, visualization, and scientific computing. Use when writing MATLAB/Octave scripts for linear algebra, signal processing, image processing, differential equations, optimization, statistics, or creating scientific visualizations. scientific-skills/skills/matplotlib.name: scientific-skills/skills/matplotlib
scientific-skills/skills/matplotlib.description: Low-level plotting library for full customization. Use when you need fine-grained control over every plot element, creating novel plot types, or integrating with specific scientific workflows. Export to PNG/PDF/SVG for publication. For quick statistical plots use seaborn; for interactive plots use plotly; for publication-ready multi-panel figures with journal styling, use scientific-visualization.

scientific-skills/skills/medchem.name: scientific-skills/skills/medchem
scientific-skills/skills/medchem.description: Medicinal chemistry filters. Apply drug-likeness rules (Lipinski, Veber), PAINS filters, structural alerts, complexity metrics, for compound prioritization and library filtering.

scientific-skills/skills/metabolomics-wo.name: scientific-skills/skills/metabolomics-workbench-database
scientific-skills/skills/metabolomics-wo.description: Access NIH Metabolomics Workbench via REST API (4,200+ studies). Query metabolites, RefMet nomenclature, MS/NMR data, m/z searches, study metadata, for metabolomics and biomarker discovery.

scientific-skills/skills/modal.name: scientific-skills/skills/modal
scientific-skills/skills/modal.description: Run Python code in the cloud with serverless containers, GPUs, and autoscaling. Use when deploying ML models, running batch processing jobs, scheduling compute-intensive tasks, or serving APIs that require GPU acceleration or dynamic scaling.

scientific-skills/skills/molfeat.name: scientific-skills/skills/molfeat
scientific-skills/skills/molfeat.description: Molecular featurization for ML (100+ featurizers). ECFP, MACCS, descriptors, pretrained models (ChemBERTa), convert SMILES to features, for QSAR and molecular ML.

scientific-skills/skills/networkx.name: scientific-skills/skills/networkx
scientific-skills/skills/networkx.description: Comprehensive toolkit for creating, analyzing, and visualizing complex networks and graphs in Python. Use when working with network/graph data structures, analyzing relationships between entities, computing graph algorithms (shortest paths, centrality, clustering), detecting communities, generating synthetic networks, or visualizing network topologies. Applicable to social networks, biological networks, transportation systems, citation networks, and any domain involving pairwise relationships.

scientific-skills/skills/neurokit2.name: scientific-skills/skills/neurokit2
scientific-skills/skills/neurokit2.description: Comprehensive biosignal processing toolkit for analyzing physiological data including ECG, EEG, EDA, RSP, PPG, EMG, and EOG signals. Use this skill when processing cardiovascular signals, brain activity, electrodermal responses, respiratory patterns, muscle activity, or eye movements. Applicable for heart rate variability analysis, event-related potentials, complexity measures, autonomic nervous system assessment, psychophysiology research, and multi-modal physiological signal integration.

scientific-skills/skills/neuropixels-ana.name: scientific-skills/skills/neuropixels-analysis
scientific-skills/skills/neuropixels-ana.description: Neuropixels neural recording analysis. Load SpikeGLX/OpenEphys data, preprocess, motion correction, Kilosort4 spike sorting, quality metrics, Allen/IBL curation, AI-assisted visual analysis, for Neuropixels 1.0/2.0 extracellular electrophysiology. Use when working with neural recordings, spike sorting, extracellular electrophysiology, or when the user mentions Neuropixels, SpikeGLX, Open Ephys, Kilosort, quality metrics, or unit curation.

scientific-skills/skills/offer-k-dense-w.name: scientific-skills/skills/offer-k-dense-web

scientific-skills/skills/omero-integrati.name: scientific-skills/skills/omero-integration
scientific-skills/skills/omero-integrati.description: Microscopy data management platform. Access images via Python, retrieve datasets, analyze pixels, manage ROIs/annotations, batch processing, for high-content screening and microscopy workflows.

scientific-skills/skills/openalex-databa.name: scientific-skills/skills/openalex-database
scientific-skills/skills/openalex-databa.description: Query and analyze scholarly literature using the OpenAlex database. scientific-skills/skills/opentargets-dat.name: scientific-skills/skills/opentargets-database
scientific-skills/skills/opentargets-dat.description: Query Open Targets Platform for target-disease associations, drug target discovery, tractability/safety data, genetics/omics evidence, known drugs, for therapeutic target identification.

scientific-skills/skills/opentrons-integ.name: scientific-skills/skills/opentrons-integration
scientific-skills/skills/opentrons-integ.description: Official Opentrons Protocol API for OT-2 and Flex robots. scientific-skills/skills/paper-2-web.name: scientific-skills/skills/paper-2-web
scientific-skills/skills/paper-2-web.description: This skill should be used when converting academic papers into promotional and presentation formats including interactive websites (Paper2Web), presentation videos (Paper2Video), and conference posters (Paper2Poster). Use this skill for tasks involving paper dissemination, conference preparation, creating explorable academic homepages, generating video abstracts, or producing print-ready posters from LaTeX or PDF sources.

scientific-skills/skills/pathml.name: scientific-skills/skills/pathml
scientific-skills/skills/pathml.description: Full-featured computational pathology toolkit. Use for advanced WSI analysis including multiplexed immunofluorescence (CODEX, Vectra), nucleus segmentation, tissue graph construction, and ML model training on pathology data. Supports 160+ slide formats. For simple tile extraction from H&E slides, histolab may be simpler.

scientific-skills/skills/pdb-database.name: scientific-skills/skills/pdb-database
scientific-skills/skills/pdb-database.description: Access RCSB PDB for 3D protein/nucleic acid structures. Search by text/sequence/structure, download coordinates (PDB/mmCIF), retrieve metadata, for structural biology and drug discovery.

scientific-skills/skills/peer-review.name: scientific-skills/skills/peer-review
scientific-skills/skills/peer-review.description: Structured manuscript/grant review with checklist-based evaluation. Use when writing formal peer reviews with specific criteria methodology assessment, statistical validity, reporting standards compliance (CONSORT/STROBE), and constructive feedback. Best for actual review writing, manuscript revision. For evaluating claims/evidence quality use scientific-critical-thinking; for quantitative scoring frameworks use scholar-evaluation.

scientific-skills/skills/pennylane.name: scientific-skills/skills/pennylane
scientific-skills/skills/pennylane.description: Hardware-agnostic quantum ML framework with automatic differentiation. Use when training quantum circuits via gradients, building hybrid quantum-classical models, or needing device portability across IBM/Google/Rigetti/IonQ. Best for variational algorithms (VQE, QAOA), quantum neural networks, and integration with PyTorch/JAX/TensorFlow. For hardware-specific optimizations use qiskit (IBM) or cirq (Google); for open quantum systems use qutip.

scientific-skills/skills/perplexity-sear.name: scientific-skills/skills/perplexity-search
scientific-skills/skills/perplexity-sear.description: Perform AI-powered web searches with real-time information using Perplexity models via LiteLLM and OpenRouter. This skill should be used when conducting web searches for current information, finding recent scientific literature, getting grounded answers with source citations, or accessing information beyond the model knowledge cutoff. Provides access to multiple Perplexity models including Sonar Pro, Sonar Pro Search (advanced agentic search), and Sonar Reasoning Pro through a single OpenRouter API key.

scientific-skills/skills/plotly.name: scientific-skills/skills/plotly
scientific-skills/skills/plotly.description: Interactive visualization library. Use when you need hover info, zoom, pan, or web-embeddable charts. Best for dashboards, exploratory analysis, and presentations. For static publication figures use matplotlib or scientific-visualization.

scientific-skills/skills/polars.name: scientific-skills/skills/polars
scientific-skills/skills/polars.description: Fast in-memory DataFrame library for datasets that fit in RAM. Use when pandas is too slow but data still fits in memory. Lazy evaluation, parallel execution, Apache Arrow backend. Best for 1-100GB datasets, ETL pipelines, faster pandas replacement. For larger-than-RAM data use dask or vaex.

scientific-skills/skills/pptx-posters.name: scientific-skills/skills/pptx-posters
scientific-skills/skills/pptx-posters.description: Create research posters using HTML/CSS that can be exported to PDF or PPTX. Use this skill ONLY when the user explicitly requests PowerPoint/PPTX poster format. For standard research posters, use latex-posters instead. This skill provides modern web-based poster design with responsive layouts and easy visual integration.

scientific-skills/skills/protocolsio-int.name: scientific-skills/skills/protocolsio-integration
scientific-skills/skills/protocolsio-int.description: Integration with protocols.io API for managing scientific protocols. Applicable for protocol discovery, collaborative protocol development, experiment tracking, lab protocol management, and scientific documentation.

scientific-skills/skills/pubchem-databas.name: scientific-skills/skills/pubchem-database
scientific-skills/skills/pubchem-databas.description: Query PubChem via PUG-REST API/PubChemPy (110M+ compounds). Search by name/CID/SMILES, retrieve properties, similarity/substructure searches, bioactivity, for cheminformatics.

scientific-skills/skills/pubmed-database.name: scientific-skills/skills/pubmed-database
scientific-skills/skills/pubmed-database.description: Direct REST API access to PubMed. Advanced Boolean/MeSH queries, E-utilities API, batch processing, citation management. For Python workflows, prefer biopython (Bio.Entrez). Use this for direct HTTP/REST work or custom API implementations.

scientific-skills/skills/pufferlib.name: scientific-skills/skills/pufferlib
scientific-skills/skills/pufferlib.description: High-performance reinforcement learning framework optimized for speed and scale. Use when you need fast parallel training, vectorized environments, multi-agent systems, or integration with game environments (Atari, Procgen, NetHack). Achieves 2-10x speedups over standard implementations. For quick prototyping or standard algorithm implementations with extensive documentation, use stable-baselines3 instead.

scientific-skills/skills/pydeseq2.name: scientific-skills/skills/pydeseq2
scientific-skills/skills/pydeseq2.description: Differential gene expression analysis (Python DESeq2). Identify DE genes from bulk RNA-seq counts, Wald tests, FDR correction, volcano/MA plots, for RNA-seq analysis.

scientific-skills/skills/pydicom.name: scientific-skills/skills/pydicom
scientific-skills/skills/pydicom.description: Python library for working with DICOM (Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine) files. Use this skill when reading, writing, or modifying medical imaging data in DICOM format, extracting pixel data from medical images (CT, MRI, X-ray, ultrasound), anonymizing DICOM files, working with DICOM metadata and tags, converting DICOM images to other formats, handling compressed DICOM data, or processing medical imaging datasets. Applies to tasks involving medical image analysis, PACS systems, radiology workflows, and healthcare imaging applications.

scientific-skills/skills/pyhealth.name: scientific-skills/skills/pyhealth
scientific-skills/skills/pyhealth.description: Comprehensive healthcare AI toolkit for developing, testing, and deploying machine learning models with clinical data. This skill should be used when working with electronic health records (EHR), clinical prediction tasks (mortality, readmission, drug recommendation), medical coding systems (ICD, NDC, ATC), physiological signals (EEG, ECG), healthcare datasets (MIMIC-III/IV, eICU, OMOP), or implementing deep learning models for healthcare applications (RETAIN, SafeDrug, Transformer, GNN).

scientific-skills/skills/pylabrobot.name: scientific-skills/skills/pylabrobot
scientific-skills/skills/pylabrobot.description: Vendor-agnostic lab automation framework. Use when controlling multiple equipment types (Hamilton, Tecan, Opentrons, plate readers, pumps) or needing unified programming across different vendors. Best for complex workflows, multi-vendor setups, simulation. For Opentrons-only protocols with official API, opentrons-integration may be simpler.

scientific-skills/skills/pymatgen.name: scientific-skills/skills/pymatgen
scientific-skills/skills/pymatgen.description: Materials science toolkit. Crystal structures (CIF, POSCAR), phase diagrams, band structure, DOS, Materials Project integration, format conversion, for computational materials science.

scientific-skills/skills/pymc.name: scientific-skills/skills/pymc
scientific-skills/skills/pymc.description: Bayesian modeling with PyMC. Build hierarchical models, MCMC (NUTS), variational inference, LOO/WAIC comparison, posterior checks, for probabilistic programming and inference.

scientific-skills/skills/pymoo.name: scientific-skills/skills/pymoo
scientific-skills/skills/pymoo.description: Multi-objective optimization framework. NSGA-II, NSGA-III, MOEA/D, Pareto fronts, constraint handling, benchmarks (ZDT, DTLZ), for engineering design and optimization problems.

scientific-skills/skills/pyopenms.name: scientific-skills/skills/pyopenms
scientific-skills/skills/pyopenms.description: Complete mass spectrometry analysis platform. Use for proteomics workflows feature detection, peptide identification, protein quantification, and complex LC-MS/MS pipelines. Supports extensive file formats and algorithms. Best for proteomics, comprehensive MS data processing. For simple spectral comparison and metabolite ID use matchms.

scientific-skills/skills/pysam.name: scientific-skills/skills/pysam
scientific-skills/skills/pysam.description: Genomic file toolkit. Read/write SAM/BAM/CRAM alignments, VCF/BCF variants, FASTA/FASTQ sequences, extract regions, calculate coverage, for NGS data processing pipelines.

scientific-skills/skills/pytdc.name: scientific-skills/skills/pytdc
scientific-skills/skills/pytdc.description: Therapeutics Data Commons. AI-ready drug discovery datasets (ADME, toxicity, DTI), benchmarks, scaffold splits, molecular oracles, for therapeutic ML and pharmacological prediction.

scientific-skills/skills/pytorch-lightni.name: scientific-skills/skills/pytorch-lightning
scientific-skills/skills/pytorch-lightni.description: Deep learning framework (PyTorch Lightning). Organize PyTorch code into LightningModules, configure Trainers for multi-GPU/TPU, implement data pipelines, callbacks, logging (W&B, TensorBoard), distributed training (DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed), for scalable neural network training.

scientific-skills/skills/qiskit.name: scientific-skills/skills/qiskit
scientific-skills/skills/qiskit.description: IBM quantum computing framework. Use when targeting IBM Quantum hardware, working with Qiskit Runtime for production workloads, or needing IBM optimization tools. Best for IBM hardware execution, quantum error mitigation, and enterprise quantum computing. For Google hardware use cirq; for gradient-based quantum ML use pennylane; for open quantum system simulations use qutip.

scientific-skills/skills/qutip.name: scientific-skills/skills/qutip
scientific-skills/skills/qutip.description: Quantum physics simulation library for open quantum systems. Use when studying master equations, Lindblad dynamics, decoherence, quantum optics, or cavity QED. Best for physics research, open system dynamics, and educational simulations. NOT for circuit-based quantum computing—use qiskit, cirq, or pennylane for quantum algorithms and hardware execution.

scientific-skills/skills/rdkit.name: scientific-skills/skills/rdkit
scientific-skills/skills/rdkit.description: Cheminformatics toolkit for fine-grained molecular control. SMILES/SDF parsing, descriptors (MW, LogP, TPSA), fingerprints, substructure search, 2D/3D generation, similarity, reactions. For standard workflows with simpler interface, use datamol (wrapper around RDKit). Use rdkit for advanced control, custom sanitization, specialized algorithms.

scientific-skills/skills/reactome-databa.name: scientific-skills/skills/reactome-database
scientific-skills/skills/reactome-databa.description: Query Reactome REST API for pathway analysis, enrichment, gene-pathway mapping, disease pathways, molecular interactions, expression analysis, for systems biology studies.

scientific-skills/skills/research-grants.name: scientific-skills/skills/research-grants

scientific-skills/skills/research-lookup.name: scientific-skills/skills/research-lookup

scientific-skills/skills/rowan.name: scientific-skills/skills/rowan
scientific-skills/skills/rowan.description: Cloud-based quantum chemistry platform with Python API. scientific-skills/skills/scanpy.name: scientific-skills/skills/scanpy
scientific-skills/skills/scanpy.description: Standard single-cell RNA-seq analysis pipeline. For deep learning models use scvi-tools; for data format questions use anndata.

scientific-skills/skills/scholar-evaluat.name: scientific-skills/skills/scholar-evaluation

scientific-skills/skills/scientific-brai.name: scientific-skills/skills/scientific-brainstorming
scientific-skills/skills/scientific-brai.description: Creative research ideation and exploration. scientific-skills/skills/scientific-crit.name: scientific-skills/skills/scientific-critical-thinking
scientific-skills/skills/scientific-crit.description: Evaluate scientific claims and evidence quality. Best for understanding evidence quality, identifying flaws. For formal peer review writing use peer-review.

scientific-skills/skills/scientific-sche.name: scientific-skills/skills/scientific-schematics

scientific-skills/skills/scientific-slid.name: scientific-skills/skills/scientific-slides
scientific-skills/skills/scientific-slid.description: Build slide decks and presentations for research talks. scientific-skills/skills/scientific-visu.name: scientific-skills/skills/scientific-visualization

scientific-skills/skills/scientific-writ.name: scientific-skills/skills/scientific-writing

scientific-skills/skills/scikit-bio.name: scientific-skills/skills/scikit-bio
scientific-skills/skills/scikit-bio.description: Biological data toolkit. Sequence analysis, alignments, phylogenetic trees, diversity metrics (alpha/beta, UniFrac), ordination (PCoA), PERMANOVA, FASTA/Newick I/O, for microbiome analysis.

scientific-skills/skills/scikit-learn.name: scientific-skills/skills/scikit-learn

scientific-skills/skills/scikit-survival.name: scientific-skills/skills/scikit-survival
scientific-skills/skills/scikit-survival.description: Comprehensive toolkit for survival analysis and time-to-event modeling in Python using scikit-survival. scientific-skills/skills/scvi-tools.name: scientific-skills/skills/scvi-tools
scientific-skills/skills/scvi-tools.description: Deep generative models for single-cell omics. Best for advanced modeling, batch effects, multimodal data. For standard analysis pipelines use scanpy.

scientific-skills/skills/seaborn.name: scientific-skills/skills/seaborn
scientific-skills/skills/seaborn.description: Statistical visualization with pandas integration. For interactive plots use plotly; for publication styling use scientific-visualization.

scientific-skills/skills/shap.name: scientific-skills/skills/shap
scientific-skills/skills/shap.description: Model interpretability and explainability using SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations). scientific-skills/skills/simpy.name: scientific-skills/skills/simpy

scientific-skills/skills/statistical-ana.name: scientific-skills/skills/statistical-analysis

scientific-skills/skills/statsmodels.name: scientific-skills/skills/statsmodels
scientific-skills/skills/statsmodels.description: Statistical models library for Python. scientific-skills/skills/sympy.name: scientific-skills/skills/sympy

scientific-skills/skills/torchdrug.name: scientific-skills/skills/torchdrug

scientific-skills/skills/torch_geometric.name: scientific-skills/skills/torch_geometric

scientific-skills/skills/transformers.name: scientific-skills/skills/transformers
